base: The urge to break free is usually accurate about the problem, but it can be reckless about the solution.
business: A practical mismatch needs adjustment; change the arrangement instead of repeating the same workaround.
shadow: Pressure escalates when each side keeps demanding terms the other cannot sustain.
arcApplying: The mismatch becomes harder to work around as exactness approaches.
arcSeparating: The pressure eases after exactness, leaving the changed arrangement to prove itself.

readerCopy.body: The urge to break free is usually accurate about the problem, but it can be reckless about the solution. When Uranus squares the North Node, the old setup may become impossible to tolerate before the replacement is actually stable, affordable, or complete. A sudden exit can remove the restriction, but it may also remove support you still rely on. Identify the specific rule, schedule, or expectation that has become intolerable, and change that part deliberately instead of asking one burst of frustration to design your entire future.
